{"model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview","key":"req-0001","response":{"candidates":[{"index":0,"content":{"parts":[{"text":"\u003ccode\u003e\nbool kissat_restarting (kissat *solver) {\n  assert (solver-\u003eunassigned);\n  if (!GET_OPTION (restart))\n    return false;\n  if (!solver-\u003elevel)\n    return false;\n  if (CONFLICTS \u003c solver-\u003elimits.restart.conflicts)\n    return false;\n  \n  // In stable mode, use Reluctant Doubling as per standard Kissat strategy.\n  // The algorithm provided modulates the LBD-based restart strategy (Glucose),\n  // which is applicable in the focused mode.\n  if (solver-\u003estable)\n    return kissat_reluctant_triggered (&solver-\u003ereluctant);\n\n  // --- Algorithm: Trail-Efficiency Modulated Glue-Protected Restarts ---\n\n  // Static state to track history across function calls\n  static double average_efficiency = 0.0;\n  static uint64_t last_propagations = 0;\n  static uint64_t last_conflicts = 0;\n  static bool initialized = false;\n\n  // Step 1: Calculate interval_efficiency\n  // We use current statistics to determine efficiency since the last actual restart.\n  uint64_t current_props = GET (propagations);\n  uint64_t current_confs = CONFLICTS;\n\n  uint64_t delta_p = current_props - last_propagations;\n  uint64_t delta_c = current_confs - last_conflicts;\n\n  double interval_efficiency = 0.0;\n  if (delta_c \u003e 0) {\n    interval_efficiency = (double) delta_p / (double) delta_c;\n  }\n\n  // Initialize EMA on first run\n  if (!initialized) {\n    average_efficiency = interval_efficiency;\n    initialized = true;\n  }\n\n  // Step 3: Determine dynamic scaling factor S\n  // (We perform Step 3 before updating the average to compare current vs history)\n  double S = 1.0;\n  if (average_efficiency \u003e 1e-9) {\n    if (interval_efficiency \u003e 1.1 * average_efficiency) {\n      S = 1.2; // High efficiency: inhibit restart\n    } else if (interval_efficiency \u003c 0.9 * average_efficiency) {\n      S = 0.8; // Low efficiency (thrashing): encourage restart\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Step 4: Check standard Glucose restart condition with scaling\n  // trigger = fast_LBD_EMA \u003e (S * 0.8 * slow_LBD_EMA)\n  const double fast = AVERAGE (fast_glue);\n  const double slow = AVERAGE (slow_glue);\n  const double threshold = S * 0.8 * slow;\n  \n  bool trigger = (fast \u003e threshold);\n\n  // Step 5: Implement 'Glue Protection'\n  // Condition: If a clause with LBD \u003c= 2 was learned within the last 50 conflicts.\n  // Implementation: Since we cannot iterate clauses or access private learner state efficiently,\n  // we use the fast glue EMA (window ~33) as a faithful proxy. If fast glue is very low (\u003c 2.0),\n  // it implies LBD \u003c= 2 clauses were learned recently.\n  if (fast \u003c 2.0) {\n    trigger = false;\n  }\n\n  // Step 2 & 6: Update state and Return\n  // We only update the average efficiency when the interval is \"completed\" by a restart trigger.\n  // This ensures the EMA reflects the efficiency of full restart intervals.\n  if (trigger) {\n    // EMA Update: alpha = 0.01\n    average_efficiency += 0.01 * (interval_efficiency - average_efficiency);\n    \n    // Update markers for next interval\n    last_propagations = current_props;\n    last_conflicts = current_confs;\n\n    kissat_extremely_verbose (solver,\n                              \"restart trigger: eff=%.2f avg=%.2f S=%.1f fast=%.2f slow=%.2f\",\n                              interval_efficiency, average_efficiency, S, fast, slow);\n  }\n\n  return trigger;\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e","thoughtSignature":""}],"role":"model"},"finishReason":"STOP"}],"responseId":"R9OKacyzKoHh_uMP6qCU0Q8","usageMetadata":{"candidatesTokenCount":952,"promptTokenCount":5866,"promptTokensDetails":[{"modality":"TEXT","tokenCount":5866}],"totalTokenCount":18365,"thoughtsTokenCount":11547},"modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview"}}
